evidence.launch_mode: headless Chrome, one fresh process per page, default GPU settings
evidence.routing: same-origin loopback only; all off-origin HTTP(S) aborted; no fulfill/substitution

corrected_target_match.method: For actual image URLs strip /WOW-Encyclopedia-Deployable-Archive from pathname; for missing-image.svg use and normalize the requested query path.
corrected_target_match.reason: The original comparison targetImages filter did not strip the project prefix, so its empty target list and passed=false are a local matcher/reporting defect, not a website failure. comparison.json is preserved unchanged.

visual_findings: On the same saved Thunder Clap URL, the default-GPU v56 capture shows broad black/blank areas within the talent-tree panels that are not comparably present in the v55 capture. v55 has red-X placeholders for its uncollected dynamic target asset; this is an expected v55 coverage difference, not a paint regression.

For the saved Slam URL, the black areas between talent cells are also visible in v55 and v56; the side-by-side captures do not isolate a new large black region in v56 beyond expected v55 missing-image placeholders and v56 added assets.

Across the four fixed hit-test points, the top stacks are ordinary image elements/wrappers or talent labels and TD/TABLE containers. Their computed visibility is visible and opacity is 1; no full-size overlay or high-z-index masking layer appears in the sampled stacks. This is limited to the sampled points and does not exclude an unsampled overlay.

The v56 target talent artwork loads as complete 36x36 images at the saved routes. In v55 those same newly covered routes resolve to the dynamic-image-uncollected missing-image fallback (intrinsic 16x16) as expected from v55 asset coverage.
Parent-provided context: a separate local --disable-gpu recheck partially improves the black-area symptom but does not remove all blank areas. This four-page comparison did not change GPU settings.
limits: This is a visual attribution comparison, not a fix.
Direct saved-URL cold loads only; no click/activation sequence was added.
The cause of the v56 Thunder Clap paint difference remains unresolved; the evidence does not establish a pure GPU raster bug or a site-level DOM bug.
No site, global GPU/network settings, or prior harness files were changed.
